links.outcome: Model discrimination (AUC) in internal versus multi-institutional external validation
links.effect: AUC 0.991 internally and 0.986 in the multi-institutional external validation cohort; performance held up externally.
links.quote: Subsequently, the AI system achieved high-fidelity predictions, with an area under the curve of 0.991 internally and 0.986 in the multi-institutional external validation cohort.

unlisted_practices: Target trial emulation to confirm safety of treatment deintensification before building AI surveillance
Risk-adapted follow-up scheduling using individualized AI-predicted failure timing

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates a multimodal transformer model using target trial emulation and multi-institutional validation to personalize cancer surveillance schedules, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
